16285088.verdict: 方向判斷錯了：預測 Inter 贏（59%），結果 4-4 平局，總進球 8 個遠超預期；半場比分預測 0-0 也錯，實際 1-2。
points: 結果判錯：平局只給了 21.5%，前三個比分（1-2、0-2、1-1）都沒中；雙方 xG 都超過 3（3.1 對 3.38），比賽節奏遠比市場和模型預想的開放。
進球大幅低估：兩隊共進 8 球，其中 2 個點球（76' Sučić、90' Kessié）；F. P. Esposito 帽子戲法加上 De Ketelaere 下半場梅開二度，這種個人表現模型看不到。
角球和犯規基本準確：Atalanta 角球 5（預測 3.4）、Inter 6（預測 6.0），犯規 9/10 對 9.2/9.3；黃牌 2/1 與預測 1.7/1.7 接近，上半場 0 張黃牌也低於預測。
半場時更新為 Inter 贏 72.6%，太相信領先一方能守住；Atalanta 主場落後還在持續施壓（全場射正 10 對 6），下半場追平的可能被低估。
16285088.lesson: When high-pressing, open sides like Atalanta face top teams, both can exceed 3 xG, so give more weight to high-scoring draws; at half-time, don't push the away win too high when the trailing home side is matching or beating them on shots on target.
16285088.verdict_en: Wrong call: we favoured Inter (59%) but it ended 4-4, with 8 goals far above expectation; the 0-0 half-time call was also wrong (actual 1-2).
points_en: Result missed: the draw got only 21.5% and none of our top three scores (1-2, 0-2, 1-1) landed; both sides topped 3 xG (3.1 vs 3.38), so the game was far more open than the market or model expected.
Goals badly underestimated: 8 goals including two penalties (76' Sučić, 90' Kessié); F. P. Esposito's hat-trick and De Ketelaere's second-half brace are individual swings the model cannot see.
Corners and fouls were roughly right: corners 5/6 vs 3.4/6.0 predicted, fouls 9/10 vs 9.2/9.3; cards 2/1 were close to 1.7/1.7, and the first half had zero cards, below our forecast.
At half-time we raised Inter's win chance to 72.6%, trusting the leader to hold on; Atalanta kept pressing at home (10 vs 6 shots on target), and their comeback chance was underrated.

16285089.verdict: 勝負和比分都猜中（首選比分 2-0、半場 1-0），但角球和黃牌高估得多，Como 在數據上的壓制沒有預期大。
points: 主勝 70% 和首選比分 2-0 完全命中，半場 1-0 也對，判斷 Como 主場防守穩、Cagliari 進攻弱是正確的。
角球偏差最大：預測 Como 7.4 個，實際只有 3 個；Como 控球 63% 卻 xG 只有 0.74，控球多但沒有轉成邊路傳中和角球。
黃牌預測合計 3.1 張，實際一張都沒有，雙方犯規也只有 18 次（預測 20.5 次），裁判判罰很寬鬆。
Como 射正 6 次進 2 球，終結效率高於 xG；3 天後要踢歐冠，可能讓他們領先後主動降低節奏，所以角球和射門都偏少。
16285089.lesson: Don't translate home possession dominance straight into high corner counts; when the favourite has a congested schedule and may manage a lead, shade corners and cards down.
16285089.verdict_en: Result and scoreline spot on (top pick 2-0, HT 1-0), but corners and cards were heavily overestimated: Como's statistical dominance was smaller than expected.
points_en: Home win at 70% and the top scoreline 2-0 both landed, as did HT 1-0; the read on Como's solid home defence and Cagliari's weak attack was correct.
Corners were the biggest miss: Como predicted 7.4, actual 3; 63% possession produced only 0.74 xG and few wide deliveries or corners.
Cards were predicted at 3.1 combined and none were shown; fouls were also lower (18 vs 20.5 predicted) with a lenient referee.
Como scored 2 from 6 shots on target, finishing above their xG; with a UCL game 3 days later they likely slowed the tempo once ahead, cutting corners and shots.

16285090.verdict: 看好 Bologna 主勝沒有兌現，最後 1-1 平局；預測的三個比分裡有 1-1，半場 0-0 只因 43 分鐘的進球而失準。
points: 勝平負方向錯：主勝 57% 沒有兌現，平局只給 25%；比分 1-1 在前三個預測比分之內。
Udinese 的 xG 達 1.65，跟 Bologna 的 1.7 幾乎一樣，遠高於賽前「K. Davis 缺陣、客隊鋒線更弱」的判斷；Zaniolo 一個人就撐起了進攻。
角球偏差最大：預測 5.4 對 4.2，實際 8 對 4，Bologna 18 次射門、全場壓著打，主隊角球被低估；上半場角球卻是 2 對 3，客隊多。
大雨和強風沒有讓比賽變沉悶，全場 29 次射門、xG 合計 3.35；黃牌 1 對 2，跟預測的 1.6 對 2.1 很接近。
16285090.lesson: 主力前鋒缺陣時，不要直接假設客隊進攻大幅下降，要看替補攻擊手（例如 Zaniolo）的能力；主隊占上風時，角球應往上調。
16285090.verdict_en: Bologna home win didn't land, game finished 1-1; 1-1 was among the three predicted scores, and the 0-0 HT call missed only because of a 43rd-minute goal.
points_en: 1X2 call wrong: 57% home win didn't land, and the draw got only 25%; the 1-1 scoreline was in the top three.
Udinese produced 1.65 xG, almost level with Bologna's 1.7 and well above the 'weaker attack without K. Davis' assumption; Zaniolo carried their attack.
Corners were the biggest miss: predicted 5.4 vs 4.2, actual 8 vs 4, as Bologna's 18 shots and pressure were underestimated; first-half corners went the other way, 2 vs 3.
Heavy rain and wind didn't kill the game: 29 shots and 3.35 combined xG; yellow cards (1 vs 2) were close to the forecast (1.6 vs 2.1).
16285090.lesson_en: When a key striker is out, don't assume the away attack collapses; check the quality of the replacement attackers (e.g. Zaniolo), and push corners up for the side expected to dominate.

16285091.verdict: Juventus 主勝和半場 0-0 都預測對了，但總進球明顯低估，下半場 18 分鐘內進了 4 球，比分遠超預測的 1-0／2-0。
points: 賽前給 Juventus 主勝 68%，方向正確；半場 0-0 也預測準確，不過半場更新時因上半場進攻效率低，把主勝降到 48%、平局升到 38%，事後看太看重上半場的低效率。
進球偏差最大：Juventus 只有 1.84 xG，卻在 53'–71' 進了 4 球（含 Kolo Muani 一個點球），8 次射正的轉化率很高；Venezia 丟第一球後防線崩潰，這種比賽走勢模型看不到。
角球高估：預測 8.2 比 3.2，實際 5 比 2；上半場 4 比 2 基本吻合，但 Juventus 下半場早早領先後不再強攻，只拿到 1 個角球。
犯規 11 比 11 和預測（11.5 比 10）很接近；資料沒有記錄任何黃牌，預測共 2.8 張，可能高估（也可能是資料缺漏），Arena 本場判罰非常寬鬆。
16285091.lesson: 強隊主場對作客連敗的弱隊，一旦打破僵局，對手很容易崩潰、被大比分擊敗；不要因天氣或賽程輪換把進球上限壓得太低，也不要因上半場 0-0 就大幅提高平局機率，而且領先之後的下半場角球要調低。
16285091.verdict_en: Juventus win and the 0-0 half-time were both called correctly, but total goals were badly underestimated: four goals in 18 second-half minutes, far beyond the predicted 1-0/2-0.
points_en: Pre-match gave Juventus a 68% win chance, which was right, and the 0-0 half-time was spot on; the half-time update cut the home win to 48% and raised the draw to 38%, giving too much weight to their poor first-half finishing.

Goals were the biggest miss: Juventus scored 4 between 53' and 71' (including a Kolo Muani penalty) from only 1.84 xG, converting 8 shots on target efficiently; Venezia collapsed after the first goal, a game-state effect the model cannot see.
Corners were overestimated: predicted 8.2 vs 3.2, actual 5 vs 2; the first half (4 vs 2) matched, but once Juventus led early in the second half they eased off and won just 1 more corner.
Fouls at 11 vs 11 were close to the prediction (11.5 vs 10); no yellow cards were recorded against 2.8 predicted, likely an overestimate (or missing data), as Arena let a lot go.
16285091.lesson_en: When a strong home side meets a team that has lost every away game, the opponent often collapses once the deadlock breaks, so don't cap the goal ceiling too hard for weather or fixture rotation, and don't sharply raise the draw chance just because it is 0-0 at half-time. Also lower second-half corners once the favourite leads.

16285092.verdict: 勝負方向和主勝都對，但比分 3-0 比預測的 1-0 大，Lazio 的勝率被三名主力缺陣壓得太低；角球也明顯低估。
points: 主勝 60% 方向正確，但首選比分 1-0、半場 0-0 都沒猜中；Lazio 半場已經 1-0 領先，最後 3-0 完勝。
xG 只有 1.13 對 0.9，3 個進球主要來自 Noslin 的高效終結和 90 分鐘 Frattesi 的補時進球，Lecce 追分時後防空檔更大。
角球偏差最大：預測 Lazio 5.0 個，實際 9 個；Lazio 領先後 Lecce 壓上，Lazio 反擊和邊路推進帶來更多角球。
黃牌合計 3 張，比預測的 3.8 張略少，上半場沒有黃牌，客隊黃牌偏多的判斷方向正確。
16285092.lesson: Don't over-discount a favourite for absentees (the 1.45 market price was closer); against a leaky away side, allow for the margin and the favourite's corner count to grow once it leads.
16285092.verdict_en: Right side and home win, but 3-0 was bigger than the predicted 1-0; Lazio's win chance was cut too much for three absentees, and corners were clearly underestimated.
points_en: Home win at 60% was correct, but the top scoreline 1-0 and HT 0-0 both missed; Lazio led 1-0 at the break and won 3-0.
xG was only 1.13 vs 0.9: the goals came from Noslin's clinical finishing and a 90th-minute Frattesi strike as Lecce opened up chasing the game.
Corners were the biggest miss: Lazio predicted 5.0, actual 9; once ahead, Lecce pushed up and Lazio's counters and wide play produced more corners.
Cards totalled 3, slightly under the 3.8 predicted, none in the first half; the lean toward more away bookings was right.

16285093.verdict: 賽前看好 Fiorentina 客勝（49.5%）完全落空，Monza 主場 3-0 大勝；比分、半場和角球分布都錯，犯規和黃牌偏高估。
points: 勝負方向錯：主勝只給 25.5%，結果 Monza 3-0；不過 xG 其實接近（1.66 比 1.78），比分差距主要來自 Monza 把握機會的效率和 Fiorentina 的浪費，不是場面一面倒。
比賽的轉折點是 45 分鐘 G. Varela 的點球，模型看不到這種偶發事件；Monza 領先後 51、59 分鐘再進兩球，Fiorentina 雖然控球和射門較多（17 腳射門、8 腳射正），卻一球未進。
角球方向判斷錯：預測 4.6 比 4.3，實際 3 比 7。Fiorentina 長時間落後並控球壓上，角球集中在客隊，這是已知的『一方主導時角球被低估』偏差。
犯規和黃牌高估：預測犯規 12.0 比 10.8、黃牌 1.8 比 1.9，實際 8 比 13、黃牌 0 比 1；Doveri 偏寬鬆的判斷是對的，但調整幅度還不夠，比分拉開後比賽也缺乏對抗強度。
16285093.lesson: When the market only mildly favours the away side (~50%) and both defences are leaky, uncertainty is high, so don't push the home win as low as 25%; cut cards further for lenient referees and plan for the trailing side piling up corners.
16285093.verdict_en: The pre-match lean to a Fiorentina away win (49.5%) failed completely as Monza won 3-0 at home; scoreline, half-time and corner split were all wrong, and fouls/cards were overestimated.
points_en: Wrong outcome: home win priced at only 25.5%, yet Monza won 3-0. xG was actually close (1.66 vs 1.78), so the margin came from Monza's finishing and Fiorentina's wastefulness, not one-sided play.

The turning point was G. Varela's 45th-minute penalty, a random event the model cannot see; Monza added goals on 51' and 59' while Fiorentina, with more possession and shots (17 shots, 8 on target), failed to score.

Corner split reversed: predicted 4.6 vs 4.3, actual 3 vs 7. Fiorentina trailed and pushed forward, so corners piled up for the away side, the known bias of underestimating corners when one side dominates.

Fouls and cards overestimated: predicted fouls 12.0 vs 10.8 and cards 1.8 vs 1.9, actual 8 vs 13 and 0 vs 1 yellows. Reading Doveri as lenient was right but the adjustment was too small, and the game lost its edge once the score gap opened.

16285094.verdict: 預測偏向平局，Genoa 上半場靠 Osmajić 梅開二度就鎖定 0-2 客勝；客勝雖是三個選項中最高的 37%，比分和半場都沒猜中。
points: 客勝 37% 是三個結果裡最高的，方向勉強算對，但最看好的比分是 1-1；實際 0-2，而且上半場就已經 0-2。
賽前說 Genoa 作客 xG 只有 0.73，結果全場 xG 2.11，上半場 1.73，兩個大機會都進了，作客進攻被嚴重低估。
Sassuolo 控球 65%、射門 25 次、xG 1.65 卻沒有進球，「連輸 5 場、主場場均進 2.0 球」裡，失球的一面比進攻的一面更準。
角球實際 5 對 3（上半場 0 對 1），比預測的 4.4 對 4.4 少；黃牌只有 1 張，遠低於預測的合計 3.9，比賽很乾淨。
16285094.lesson: 主隊在連敗、防守崩潰時，別因為天氣惡劣就加重平局；對手的作客 xG 樣本少，應往聯賽平均拉回，不能直接當成弱點。
16285094.verdict_en: Leaned towards a draw, but Osmajić's first-half brace sealed a 0-2 Genoa win; the away win was the top outcome at 37%, but the score and HT calls missed.
points_en: Away win at 37% was the highest of the three outcomes, so the direction was roughly right, but the top score was 1-1; it ended 0-2, and it was already 0-2 at half-time.
Genoa's away xG of 0.73 was used as a weakness, yet they produced 2.11 xG (1.73 in the first half) and scored both big chances.
Sassuolo had 65% possession, 25 shots and 1.65 xG but no goal; of their '5 straight losses, 2.0 home goals per game' profile, the defensive side was the more reliable signal.
Corners came in at 5 vs 3 (0 vs 1 in the first half), below the 4.4 vs 4.4 forecast; only one yellow card versus about 3.9 predicted, a clean game.
16285094.lesson_en: When the home side is on a losing run with a leaking defence, don't let bad weather inflate the draw; shrink a small-sample away xG towards the league average instead of treating it as a weakness.

16285095.verdict: 方向和半場比分都猜對了（Roma 勝、半場 0-1），但大大低估了比分差距和 Roma 的角球數；犯規和黃牌則明顯高估。
points: Roma 勝的機率給了 76%，半場 0-1 也猜中；不過預測比分最大只到 0-3，實際是 1-5。Malen 一人進 4 球，屬於個人狀態爆發，模型看不到單一球員的影響。
下半場 Parma 54 分鐘扳平後必須壓上，後防空檔變大，Roma 在 68 到 90 分鐘連進 4 球；半場時我反而把勝平負往保守方向調（比分改成 0-1、0-2），判斷錯了。
Parma 的 xG 有 1.98、射門 17 次，比賽並不是單方面壓制。Roma 這麼大的比分差，主要來自射門轉化率極高，不是 xG 上的絕對優勢（2.96）。
犯規預測 10 對 11，實際只有 6 對 9；黃牌預測合計 3.5 張，實際只有 1 張。裁判 Sozza 這場出牌很寬鬆，『Parma 被壓著打，犯規會偏多』的假設不成立。Roma 角球 8 個，也高於預測的 7 個。
16285095.lesson: When an away side is a heavy favourite against a weak home team, an equaliser forces the underdog forward and opens space for counter-attacks, so leave room for a fat tail of big scorelines; don't use the referee's season card average as the forecast directly, weight it against how physical the two teams' actual play is likely to be.
16285095.verdict_en: Direction and half-time score were right (Roma win, 0-1 at HT), but the margin and Roma's corners were badly underestimated, while fouls and cards were clearly overestimated.
points_en: Roma win was given 76% and the 0-1 half-time score was correct, but the biggest predicted scoreline was 0-3 against an actual 1-5. Malen scored four, an individual hot streak the model cannot see.

After Parma equalised in the 54th minute they had to push forward and left space at the back; Roma scored four times between minutes 68 and 90. At half-time I made the call more conservative (0-1, 0-2 scorelines), which was the wrong way.
Parma had 1.98 xG from 17 shots, so this was not one-way traffic. The big margin came mostly from Roma's extreme finishing, not a dominant xG edge (2.96).

Predicted fouls were 10 vs 11, actual 6 vs 9; predicted cards totalled 3.5, actual was 1. Sozza was lenient, and the idea that Parma would foul more while pinned back did not hold. Roma's 8 corners also beat the predicted 7.

16285096.verdict: 賽果、比分和半場比分全部命中，1-0 正好是首選比分；主要偏差在角球和犯規分布，Napoli 的壓制比預測更明顯。
points: 勝平負給 Napoli 59% 和首選比分 1-0 都命中，半場 0-0 也對；xG 1.66 對 0.55、射正 10 對 2，Napoli 贏得名正言順。
角球低估了 Napoli：預測 5.6 對 4.0，實際 8 對 5，總數 13 也高於預測的 9.6，再次印證一方主導時模型會低估角球。
犯規方向判斷相反：預測 Napoli 10.2、Torino 11.3，實際 13 對 8；上半場黃牌預測合計 1.0，實際 0，三張黃牌都出現在下半場。
半場檢討時因為 0-0 把平局調高到 35%，但當時 xG 1.31 對 0.07 已經顯示壓制明顯，事後看 Napoli 的勝率不應該下調這麼多。
16285096.lesson: 主隊大幅壓制、半場仍 0-0 時，不要過度調高平局，同時要調高主隊角球；主導比賽的一方犯規也可能更多。
16285096.verdict_en: Result, scoreline and half-time score all correct, with 1-0 as the top pick; the main misses were the corner and foul splits, as Napoli dominated even more than expected.
points_en: The 59% Napoli win and the top scoreline of 1-0 both landed, and so did the 0-0 at half-time; xG 1.66 vs 0.55 and shots on target 10 vs 2 made it a deserved win.
Napoli's corners were underestimated: predicted 5.6 vs 4.0, actual 8 vs 5. The total of 13 beat the predicted 9.6, which again shows corners are underestimated when one side dominates.
Fouls went the opposite way: predicted Napoli 10.2 and Torino 11.3, actual 13 vs 8. First-half yellows were predicted at 1.0 in total but none came; all three cards were in the second half.
At half-time the draw was raised to 35% because of the 0-0, but xG of 1.31 vs 0.07 already showed clear dominance, so looking back Napoli's win chance should not have been cut that much.
16285096.lesson_en: When the home side clearly dominates but it is still 0-0 at half-time, don't push the draw up too far, and raise the home side's corners. The dominant side can also commit more fouls.

16285098.verdict: Milan 勝的方向判斷正確（60%），但總進球、Frosinone 的角球和犯規、黃牌都明顯低估，比分 5-1 遠超預測的 2-1。
points: 勝平負方向正確：Milan 主勝是最高機率的選項；第4分鐘的烏龍球讓比賽很早就向 Milan 傾斜，模型看不到這種偶發的早段進球。
總進球6個，遠高於預測的約3個：Milan 射正8次就進了5球，終結效率極高。Frosinone 射門15次，xG 只有1.03，下半場壓上進攻後被反擊打穿，大比分是落後方冒險壓上造成的。
角球判斷大致對（Frosinone 多），但低估了：實際是2比9，預測是3.7比5.8。落後方長時間壓上，角球會集中在一方，這是已知的偏差。
犯規和黃牌被過度下調：Frosinone 犯規17次、4張黃牌，預測是13.5次、2.0張。因為 Pairetto 判罰寬鬆而往下調是錯的；落後方追趕和防守反擊時的戰術犯規更多。
16285098.lesson: When an away underdog falls behind early and commits forward, raise the favourite's counter-attack goals and the underdog's corners and fouls/cards together; don't cut the underdog's cards heavily just because the referee is lenient.
16285098.verdict_en: Milan win called correctly (60%), but total goals, Frosinone corners, fouls and cards were clearly underestimated; 5-1 far exceeded the predicted 2-1.
points_en: Result direction right: home win was the top pick; a 4th-minute own goal tilted the game early, a random event the model cannot see.

Six goals vs about three expected: Milan scored 5 from 8 shots on target with elite finishing, while Frosinone took 15 shots for only 1.03 xG and were punished on the counter after pushing forward in the second half.
Corner direction right (Frosinone more) but magnitude too low: 2-9 actual vs 3.7-5.8 predicted; a trailing side pressing for long spells concentrates corners, a known bias.

Fouls and cards were cut too far: Frosinone had 17 fouls and 4 yellows vs 13.5 and 2.0 predicted. The downgrade for Pairetto's lenient style backfired, since chasing the game and tactical fouls against counters pushed the numbers up.

16285088.verdict: Inter controlled the first half, with 68% possession and 1.85 xG. F. P. Esposito scored twice, so our 0-0 half-time call was wrong, though the direction (Inter ahead) was right.
points: The half-time score was 1-2, not the 0-0 we predicted. First-half goals were 1 and 2 against our 0.5 and 0.9. Inter created 4 big chances to Atalanta's 1, and Esposito scored at 16' and 32'. We underestimated how efficient Inter's attack would be, but the call that Inter would be stronger was right. Elmas pulled one back at 35', so both teams have already scored.

Corners were 2-4 against our 1.6-2.9, a little higher than predicted, in line with Inter's dominance. Fouls were 4-5 against our 4.1-4.4, almost exact. There were no yellow cards against our 0.4-0.7, so the first half was cleaner than expected.

Inter made a forced injury substitution at 33'. The model can't see individual players, so we can't measure how much this affects their attack or defence. Atalanta's 3 offsides show they have been trying to get in behind.
16285088.headline: Atalanta will push forward to equalise, which should bring them more corners and should open spaces for Inter's counter-attacks. Inter can sit on the lead and look for a third on the break. An Inter win is still the most likely result.
16285088.changes: An Inter win goes up from 59.0% to 72.6%, and a draw drops from 21.5% to 19.2%. The most likely full-time score stays 1-2, with 1-3 now second. Since 3 goals are already in, over 2.5 goals and both teams to score are both 100%. Atalanta's full-time corners go up to 5.0, because the trailing team usually earns more corners. Fouls rise slightly, as the second half is likely to be more physical. Yellow cards come down to 1.1-1.0, because there were none in the first half.
16285088.verdict_en: Inter controlled the first half, with 68% possession and 1.85 xG. F. P. Esposito scored twice, so our 0-0 half-time call was wrong, though the direction (Inter ahead) was right.
points_en: The half-time score was 1-2, not the 0-0 we predicted. First-half goals were 1 and 2 against our 0.5 and 0.9. Inter created 4 big chances to Atalanta's 1, and Esposito scored at 16' and 32'. We underestimated how efficient Inter's attack would be, but the call that Inter would be stronger was right. Elmas pulled one back at 35', so both teams have already scored.

Corners were 2-4 against our 1.6-2.9, a little higher than predicted, in line with Inter's dominance. Fouls were 4-5 against our 4.1-4.4, almost exact. There were no yellow cards against our 0.4-0.7, so the first half was cleaner than expected.

Inter made a forced injury substitution at 33'. The model can't see individual players, so we can't measure how much this affects their attack or defence. Atalanta's 3 offsides show they have been trying to get in behind.
16285088.headline_en: Atalanta will push forward to equalise, which should bring them more corners and should open spaces for Inter's counter-attacks. Inter can sit on the lead and look for a third on the break. An Inter win is still the most likely result.
16285088.changes_en: An Inter win goes up from 59.0% to 72.6%, and a draw drops from 21.5% to 19.2%. The most likely full-time score stays 1-2, with 1-3 now second. Since 3 goals are already in, over 2.5 goals and both teams to score are both 100%. Atalanta's full-time corners go up to 5.0, because the trailing team usually earns more corners. Fouls rise slightly, as the second half is likely to be more physical. Yellow cards come down to 1.1-1.0, because there were none in the first half.

16285089.verdict: Como 的半場 1-0 和賽前預測完全一致，但比賽比較平均，Como 並沒有明顯壓制對手。
points: 半場比分 1-0 和上半場進球 [1,0] 都猜對了（預測 [1.0,0.3]）。J. Ramón 第 24 分鐘進球，Como 全場只有 1 腳射正，算是效率高。
兩隊 xG 差不多（0.35 對 0.33），大機會各 1 次。Kean、Diao 缺陣後，Como 進攻威脅明顯減弱，控球 56% 也談不上壓制。
角球 2-0 比預測的 3.3-1.3 少。犯規 4-4，Cagliari 比預測的 5.6 次乾淨。上半場沒有黃牌，比預測少。
16285089.headline: Cagliari 下半場要壓上，Como 可以打反擊擴大比分，不過 3 天後要踢歐冠，換人可能會偏保守。
16285089.changes: 主勝由 70% 提高到 78%，因為已經領先一球。最可能比分由 2-0 改成 1-0，因為兩隊 xG 都低，比賽節奏慢。全場角球、犯規、黃牌都調低，因為上半場數字低於預期。客隊落後要追分，所以下半場的角球和犯規會略多一些。
16285089.verdict_en: Como's 1-0 half-time lead matches the pre-match call exactly, but the half was even and Como never really dominated.
points_en: Half-time score 1-0 and first-half goals [1,0] were correct (predicted [1.0,0.3]). J. Ramón scored in the 24th minute from Como's only shot on target, so it was an efficient half.
xG was almost level (0.35 vs 0.33) with one big chance each. Without Kean and Diao, Como's attack lacked threat, and 56% possession was not dominance.
Corners 2-0 came in under the predicted 3.3-1.3. Fouls were 4-4, so Cagliari were cleaner than the predicted 5.6. There were no yellow cards, fewer than predicted.
16285089.headline_en: Cagliari must push forward in the second half, giving Como counter-attacking chances, though their changes may be cautious with a UCL game in 3 days.
16285089.changes_en: Home win raised from 70% to 78% because Como already lead by a goal. Most likely score changed from 2-0 to 1-0 because both teams' xG is low and the game is slow. Full-time corners, fouls and cards lowered because first-half numbers were below expectation. Cagliari chasing the game should add a few second-half corners and fouls.

16285090.verdict: Bologna 在上半場略占上風，xG 0.62 對 0.21，43 分鐘由 Zortea 打破僵局；賽前預測的半場 0-0 只差最後兩分鐘。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0，實際 1-0。上半進球預期 0.6 對 0.3，和實際的 1 比 0 相差不大，進球出現在上半場末段；雨天比賽節奏偏慢，和賽前判斷一致。
角球預測主隊較多（2.3 對 1.6），實際 Udinese 3 個、Bologna 2 個，客隊沒有前鋒 K. Davis，靠定位球和邊路找機會。
犯規 6 對 5、黃牌 0 對 1（Palma 6 分鐘就吃牌），和預測的 5.0 對 6.9、0.4 對 1.0 大致吻合，客隊犯規比預期少。
16285090.headline: Udinese 下半場要壓上，但上半場只有 0.21 xG，鋒線威脅很小；Bologna 守住領先或打反擊擴大比分的機會較大。
16285090.changes: 主勝從 57% 升到 77.5%，因為已經領先一球，客隊進攻又很弱；最可能比分仍是 1-0。客隊落後要壓上，所以全場角球改成客隊較多（5.5 對 4.3）；Palma 已有黃牌會收斂，客隊犯規下調到 11.0。
16285090.verdict_en: Bologna edged the first half (xG 0.62 vs 0.21) and Zortea broke the deadlock on 43'. The predicted 0-0 half-time was only two minutes from being right.
points_en: Predicted HT 0-0, actual 1-0. First-half goal expectation of 0.6 vs 0.3 was close to the actual 1-0, with the goal coming late. The slow, rainy tempo matched the pre-match read.
We expected Bologna to take more corners (2.3 vs 1.6), but Udinese won 3 to 2. Without striker K. Davis, they relied on set pieces and wide play.
Fouls 6-5 and cards 0-1 (Palma booked on 6') were broadly in line with the 5.0/6.9 and 0.4/1.0 forecast; Udinese fouled less than expected.
16285090.headline_en: Udinese must push forward in the second half, but they managed only 0.21 xG before the break. Bologna are more likely to hold the lead or add a second on the counter.
16285090.changes_en: Home win raised from 57% to 77.5% given the one-goal lead and Udinese's weak attack; 1-0 is still the most likely score. Udinese chasing the game means they should now take more corners (5.5 vs 4.3); their foul count is cut to 11.0 because Palma, already booked, will hold back.

16285091.verdict: Juventus 控球和角球佔優，但進攻效率很低，上半場 0-0 符合賽前預測。Venezia 的 xG 反而略高。
points: 半場比分 0-0 猜中。上半場進球預測為 0.8 比 0.3，實際兩隊都沒有進球。Juventus 雖然有 2 腳射正，xG 只有 0.16，Venezia 也只有 0.3，雙方都缺少高質量機會。
角球 4 比 2，大致符合主隊壓制的預測（3.9 比 1.3），Venezia 略多於預期。
犯規 2 比 5，Juventus 的犯規比預測的 5.5 少得多。上半場沒有黃牌，符合裁判 Arena 少出牌的習慣。
16285091.headline: 下半場 Juventus 會繼續壓上，Venezia 會收縮防守、伺機反擊。主隊仍佔優，但一球小勝或平局的可能性都很高。
16285091.changes: 主勝從 68% 降到 48%，平局從 20% 升到 38%，原因是上半場沒有進球，而且 Juventus 的 xG 很低。最可能比分從 1-0 改為 0-0 和 1-0。總進球預期下調，大 2.5 球只有約 13%。Juventus 全場犯規從 11.5 降到 6.5，Venezia 落後時間少、防守時間長，犯規提高到 11.0。角球大致不變，黃牌因為上半場沒有出牌而小幅下調。
16285091.verdict_en: Juventus dominated possession and corners but created little, so the 0-0 half-time matched the forecast. Venezia actually had the higher xG.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right. First-half goals were forecast at 0.8 vs 0.3, but neither side scored. Juventus had 2 shots on target yet only 0.16 xG, and Venezia had 0.3, so clear chances were scarce.
Corners were 4-2, broadly in line with the forecast of home dominance (3.9 vs 1.3). Venezia won slightly more than expected.
Fouls were 2-5, with Juventus committing far fewer than the forecast 5.5. No yellow cards in the half, consistent with referee Arena's lenient record.
16285091.headline_en: Juventus will keep pushing in the second half while Venezia sit deep and look to counter. The home side are still favourites, but a narrow win or a draw are both very possible.
16285091.changes_en: Home win cut from 68% to 48% and the draw raised from 20% to 38%, because the first half was goalless and Juventus' xG was very low. Most likely score changed from 1-0 to 0-0 and 1-0. Total goal expectation lowered, with over 2.5 goals now only about 13%. Juventus full-time fouls cut from 11.5 to 6.5; Venezia, defending for longer, raised to 11.0. Corners roughly unchanged; yellow cards trimmed slightly after a card-free first half.

16285092.verdict: Lazio 領先 1-0，但進球和場面不相符：上半場 Lecce 的機會反而更多。
points: 賽前預測半場 0-0，猜錯了。Noslin 第 25 分鐘進球，Lazio 整個上半場 xG 只有 0.13，進球有運氣成分。
Lecce 射門 6 對 2，xG 0.51 對 0.13，壓過 Lazio。Zaccagni、Tavares 缺陣，Lazio 左路少了推進，越位 5 次也說明進攻配合不順。
角球 4-1 比預測的 2.3-1.8 多，主隊多。犯規 3-4 和黃牌 0 都低於預測，裁判 Marcenaro 上半場沒有出牌。
16285092.headline: Lecce 下半場會繼續壓上找機會。Lazio 如果不能提升進攻質量，扳平的風險不小。
16285092.changes: 主勝由 60% 提高到 71%，因為已經領先。但 Lecce 上半場機會更多，所以平局仍然保留約 21%。最可能比分維持 1-0，1-1 升到第二。Lazio 上半場角球多，所以全場角球調高。犯規和黃牌按上半場的低節奏略微調低。
16285092.verdict_en: Lazio lead 1-0, but the score doesn't reflect the half: Lecce created more.
points_en: The pre-match call of 0-0 at half-time was wrong. Noslin scored in the 25th minute even though Lazio's first-half xG was only 0.13, so luck played a part.
Lecce outshot Lazio 6-2 with xG 0.51 vs 0.13. Without Zaccagni and Tavares, Lazio lacked drive down the left, and 5 offsides show their attack was out of sync.
Corners 4-1 were above the predicted 2.3-1.8, mostly for the home side. Fouls 3-4 and zero cards were below prediction; referee Marcenaro showed no cards in the first half.
16285092.headline_en: Lecce will keep pushing for chances in the second half. Unless Lazio's attack improves, there is a real risk of an equaliser.
16285092.changes_en: Home win raised from 60% to 71% because Lazio lead. A draw stays at about 21% because Lecce had more chances. Most likely score stays 1-0, with 1-1 moving up to second. Full-time corners raised because Lazio won more corners in the first half. Fouls and cards trimmed slightly to match the slow first-half tempo.

16285093.verdict: 賽前看好客隊，但上半場 Monza 靠 45 分鐘 G. Varela 的點球 1-0 領先；xG 1.23 比 0.23，Fiorentina 雖然控球多，進攻威脅很小。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 不對：Monza 上半場 xG 1.23（點球約占 0.76），還有 1 次絕佳機會；Fiorentina 雖然有 3 腳射正，但 xG 只有 0.23，射門質量很差。上半場進球預測（主 0.6、客 0.8）方向相反。
角球 1 比 4，比預測的 2.2 比 2.0 更偏向 Fiorentina，反映客隊控球 54% 並持續在邊路推進；犯規 4 比 7，客隊比預測多，兩隊合計 11 次接近預測的 9.5。
上半場兩隊都沒有黃牌，比預測的 0.6 比 0.7 還少，符合裁判 Doveri 執法寬鬆的判斷；Fiorentina 27 分鐘因傷換人，打亂了原本的部署。
16285093.headline: 下半場 Fiorentina 必須壓上追分，角球和控球會更偏向客隊；Monza 退守反擊，有機會打出空檔擴大比分，但能否守住領先要看後防的穩定性。
16285093.changes: 賽前看好客勝（49.5%），現在改為 Monza 勝 55%（剩下約 45 分鐘，主隊領先一球，客隊上半場射門質量又差）；最可能比分從 1-1 改為 1-0；客隊角球由 4.3 調高到 7.0，主隊由 4.6 調低到 3.0；主隊領先後防守和拖延時間，犯規和黃牌調高；客隊上半場犯規偏多，所以全場犯規也調高。
16285093.verdict_en: Fiorentina were favourites, but Monza lead 1-0 at half-time thanks to G. Varela's 45th-minute penalty; xG is 1.23 vs 0.23, and Fiorentina's extra possession produced little threat.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was wrong: Monza posted 1.23 xG (about 0.76 of it from the penalty) plus one big chance. Fiorentina had 3 shots on target but only 0.23 xG, so their shot quality was poor. The first-half goals call (0.6 home, 0.8 away) had it the wrong way round.

Corners went 1-4, more lopsided toward Fiorentina than the 2.2-2.0 forecast, reflecting their 54% possession and steady wide pressure. Fouls went 4-7, with the away side fouling more than expected; the combined 11 was close to the predicted 9.5.

There were no yellow cards in the first half, even fewer than the 0.6-0.7 forecast, which fits the read on lenient referee Doveri. Fiorentina's 27th-minute injury substitution disrupted their original setup.
16285093.headline_en: Fiorentina must push forward in the second half, so corners and possession will tilt further their way. Monza will sit deep and counter, with chances to extend the lead on the break, but holding on depends on how steady their defence stays.
16285093.changes_en: Before kick-off we favoured an away win (49.5%); now Monza are 55% to win (about 45 minutes left, the home side a goal up, and Fiorentina's shot quality poor in the first half). The most likely score moves from 1-1 to 1-0. Away corners go up from 4.3 to 7.0 and home corners down from 4.6 to 3.0. Home fouls and cards go up because Monza will defend and run down the clock, and away fouls go up after a foul-heavy first half.

16285094.verdict: Genoa 打得很有效率，xG 1.73，兩個大機會由 Osmajić 梅開二度；Sassuolo 控球多卻沒有威脅，賽前看好的平局走勢完全落空。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0，實際 0-2。賽前認為 Genoa 作客進攻很弱（xG 0.73），結果他們上半場就創造 3 次大機會，Sassuolo 防線延續場均失 2.6 球的問題。
角球預測每隊約 2 個，實際只有 0 對 1，大雨強風下雙方很少有邊路傳中，角球嚴重高估。
犯規 4 對 6、黃牌 0 對 0，比預測的 5.2 對 5.4、0.5 對 0.6 略少，雙方都還沒吃牌。
16285094.headline: Sassuolo 主場落後兩球會全力壓上，可能進一球挽回顏面，但後防空檔大，Genoa 打反擊再進球的機會也不小。
16285094.changes: 由賽前的三種結果接近（客勝 37%）改成客勝 88.5%，因為領先兩球而且 xG 也明顯占優。上半場角球很少，全場角球從 4.4 對 4.4 下調到 3.8 對 2.6，主隊壓上後角球較多；Genoa 守領先、拖延時間，犯規和黃牌上調。
16285094.verdict_en: Genoa were ruthless: 1.73 xG, three big chances and an Osmajić brace. Sassuolo had more of the ball but no threat, and the expected cagey draw never happened.
points_en: Predicted HT 0-0, actual 0-2. We rated Genoa's away attack as weak (xG 0.73), yet they created 3 big chances, and Sassuolo's defence (2.6 conceded per game) kept leaking.
We expected about 2 corners each but got 0-1. Heavy rain and wind limited wide crosses, so corners were heavily overestimated.
Fouls 4-6 and no cards were slightly below the 5.2/5.4 and 0.5/0.6 forecast; neither side has been booked yet.
16285094.headline_en: Two down at home, Sassuolo will throw everything forward and may grab a consolation goal, but the gaps they leave give Genoa good chances to score again on the counter.
16285094.changes_en: Moved from a near three-way split (37% away win) to 88.5% Genoa, given the two-goal lead and clear xG edge. After so few first-half corners, full-time corners are cut from 4.4/4.4 to 3.8/2.6, with Sassuolo taking more as they push. Genoa's fouls and cards are raised because they will defend the lead and waste time.

16285095.verdict: 半場比分 0-1 猜對了，但 Parma 的表現比預期好得多：xG 1.5 對 0.62、射門 12 對 8，Roma 靠 Malen 的進球和門將 4 次撲救才領先。
points: 半場 0-1、上半場進球、犯規（5-4）和黃牌（1-0）都和預測接近；只有角球低估了，預測 1.3-3.5，實際 3-5，雙方都比預期多。
預測錯在場面：原以為 Parma 會被壓著打，但 Roma 控球 69% 卻沒有壓住對手。Parma 反擊和定位球很有威脅，12 腳射門、4 腳射正，xG 1.5 反而比 Roma 高。
Roma 這次進攻不如預期，xG 只有 0.62，還有 3 次越位，但效率更高，39 分鐘 Malen 進球。Valeri 吃了黃牌，下半場出腳會比較收斂。
16285095.headline: Parma 落後一球，下半場會壓上，Roma 可以打反擊擴大比分；但 Parma 上半場已經證明有機會，扳平的可能不小。
16285095.changes: 主隊的進球預期從約 0.3 提高到 0.6，雙方都進球的機率也跟著提高，因為 Parma 上半場 xG 1.5，創造機會的能力比賽前估計的強。Roma 已經領先，客勝機率維持在 77% 左右。最可能比分從 0-2 改為 0-1。角球上調到 6.0-7.5，因為上半場已有 3-5，加上 Parma 要追分。犯規略增，黃牌主隊 2.0、客隊 1.2，裁判 Sozza 執法尺度偏嚴，下半場比賽會更膠著。
16285095.verdict_en: The 0-1 half-time call was right, but Parma were much better than expected: xG 1.5 to 0.62 and 12 shots to 8. Roma lead thanks to Malen's goal and four saves from their keeper.
points_en: Half-time score, first-half goals, fouls (5-4) and yellows (1-0) were close to the forecast. Only corners were underestimated: we predicted 1.3-3.5 and it was 3-5, more for both sides.

Where the forecast went wrong was the shape of the game. We expected Parma to be pinned back, but Roma's 69% possession didn't control them. Parma were dangerous on the break and from set pieces: 12 shots, 4 on target, and higher xG than Roma.
Roma's attack was weaker than expected (xG 0.62, 3 offsides) but more clinical, with Malen scoring on 39'. Valeri is on a yellow and will have to be more careful in the second half.
16285095.headline_en: A goal down, Parma will push forward in the second half, which gives Roma room to counter and extend the lead. But Parma have already shown they can create chances, so an equaliser is a real possibility.
16285095.changes_en: Parma's expected goals go up from about 0.3 to 0.6, and both-teams-to-score goes up with them, because their first-half xG of 1.5 shows they create more than we thought. Roma already lead, so the away win stays around 77%. Most likely score changes from 0-2 to 0-1. Corners go up to 6.0-7.5: it was already 3-5 at the break and Parma must chase. Fouls rise slightly; yellows are 2.0 for Parma and 1.2 for Roma, as referee Sozza is strict and the second half should be tighter.

16285096.verdict: 半場 0-0 和預測一致，但 Napoli 壓制得比預期更明顯：xG 1.31 對 0.07，射門 13 對 4，只是沒有把機會變成進球。
points: 半場比分 0-0 猜對，但上半場預期進球 0.8/0.4 不夠準：Napoli 製造了 1.31 xG 和 1 次絕佳機會，射門只有 3 次射正，被 Torino 門將撲出；Torino 進攻幾乎沒有威脅，xG 只有 0.07。
角球 4-1，Napoli 比預測的 2.6 多，Torino 比預測的 1.9 少，正好反映 Napoli 單方面施壓（模型本來就容易低估一隊主導比賽時的角球）；犯規 6-3，Torino 只有 3 次，遠低於預測的 5.3，主要是他們退守得很深，沒有主動上前逼搶。
上半場沒有黃牌（預測 0.4/0.6）。兩隊各有一次傷病換人（13' Napoli、40' Torino），比賽節奏多次中斷；模型看不到被換下的是誰，所以這兩次換人的影響無法量化。
16285096.headline: 下半場 Napoli 會繼續圍攻，關鍵在於能不能把壓制轉化成進球；Torino 只要守住，平局機會不小，但他們能打出的威脅只剩偶爾的反擊。
16285096.changes: 主勝從 59% 降到 48%，平局從 23% 升到 35%，因為只剩 45 分鐘而且還是 0-0；客勝 18% 小幅降到 17%，Torino 的進攻產出非常低。比分首選維持 1-0，第二選擇改成 0-0。全場角球改為 7.3/3.2（賽前 5.6/4.0），Napoli 的單方面壓制會延續；Torino 的犯規下調到 8.5（賽前 11.3），因為他們採取深度防守；黃牌改為 0.9/1.3，略低於賽前，因為上半場一張都沒有。大 2.5 球只剩約 18%。
16285096.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but Napoli dominated more than expected (xG 1.31 vs 0.07, shots 13-4) without converting.
points_en: HT score 0-0 was correct, but the 1H goal expectation of 0.8/0.4 was off: Napoli created 1.31 xG and one big chance, with only 3 shots on target, all saved by the Torino keeper. Torino offered almost nothing in attack (0.07 xG).

Corners went 4-1: more for Napoli than the predicted 2.6 and fewer for Torino than 1.9, which reflects one-way pressure (the model tends to underestimate corners when one side dominates). Fouls went 6-3: Torino's 3 was well below the predicted 5.3 because they sat in a deep block instead of pressing.
No yellow cards (predicted 0.4/0.6). Each side made an injury substitution (13' Napoli, 40' Torino), which broke up the rhythm. The model can't see who went off, so their impact can't be quantified.
16285096.headline_en: Napoli will keep pushing in the second half, and everything hinges on turning that pressure into a goal. If Torino hold firm a draw is very possible, but their only threat is the occasional counter.
16285096.changes_en: Home win cut from 59% to 48% and draw raised from 23% to 35%, since it is still 0-0 with only 45 minutes left. Away win dips slightly from 18% to 17% given Torino's very low attacking output. 1-0 stays the top scoreline, with 0-0 now second. Full-time corners revised to 7.3/3.2 (pre-match 5.6/4.0) as Napoli's dominance continues. Torino fouls cut to 8.5 (from 11.3) because of their deep block. Cards revised to 0.9/1.3, slightly below pre-match since there were none in the first half. Over 2.5 goals is now only about 18%.

16285098.verdict: Milan 開場靠烏龍球早早領先，上半場比分和進球數都比預測多，不過 Frosinone 射門更多、xG 接近，Milan 並沒有壓制對手。
points: 半場比分預測 1-0，實際 2-1：4' Calvani 的烏龍球加上 19' G. Ramos 進球，讓上半場進球比預期的 0.9/0.5 多；25' Masini 扳回一球，xG 只是 0.69 對 0.61，兩隊旗鼓相當。
角球 2-4，和預測的 2.0/2.3 方向一致（Frosinone 角球更多），Frosinone 射門 9 對 5，說明 Milan 角球少的判斷沒錯。
犯規 2-9、黃牌 0-2 偏差最大：Frosinone 防守時犯規多，Cittadini 和 Calò 都已經吃到黃牌；Milan 犯規遠低於預測的 5 次。
16285098.headline: Frosinone 下半場要追分，會繼續壓上；Milan 可以打反擊擴大比分，但如果守不住，平局的機會仍有兩成左右。
16285098.changes: 主勝從 60% 升到 70.5%（已經領先一球、只剩 45 分鐘），客勝從 19% 降到 8.5%；最可能比分仍是 2-1，大 2.5 球和雙方都進球已經成立；Frosinone 全場角球上調到 7.0，犯規上調到 14.5，黃牌上調到 2.8（Pairetto 實際判罰不算寬鬆）；Milan 犯規下調到 7.5，下半場守成時會增加一些。
16285098.verdict_en: An early own goal put Milan ahead and the first half produced more goals than predicted, but Frosinone had more shots and similar xG, so Milan were not in control.
points_en: Predicted HT 1-0, actual 2-1: Calvani's 4' own goal and G. Ramos on 19' beat the expected 0.9/0.5 first-half goals; Masini pulled one back on 25', and xG was only 0.69 vs 0.61, so the teams were even.
Corners 2-4 went the predicted way (Frosinone more), and Frosinone had 9 shots to 5, so the call that Milan would win few corners was right.
Fouls 2-9 and yellows 0-2 were the biggest misses: Frosinone fouled a lot while defending, and Cittadini and Calò are both booked; Milan fouled far less than the 5 predicted.
16285098.headline_en: Frosinone must chase the game and will keep pushing forward; Milan can hit them on the break, but a draw still has roughly a one-in-five chance if Milan fail to hold on.
16285098.changes_en: Home win up from 60% to 70.5% (one goal ahead with 45 minutes left), away win down from 19% to 8.5%; 2-1 is still the most likely score, and over 2.5 goals and BTTS have already landed. Frosinone full-time corners raised to 7.0, fouls to 14.5 and yellows to 2.8 (Pairetto is not refereeing leniently). Milan fouls cut to 7.5, though they will rise a little as Milan protect the lead.

rules.zh: 勝平負以去水後的市場機率為主軸，AI 調整一般不超過 ±5 個百分點；只有確認的重大陣容消息（主力門將或兩名以上主力確定缺陣）才可以調到 ±8。不要因為傷停把熱門隊的勝率壓得比市場低很多。
rules.en: Anchor 1X2 on de-vigged market probabilities and keep AI adjustments within ±5 pts; go up to ±8 only on confirmed major team news (first-choice keeper, or two or more key starters ruled out). Don't push a favourite well below the market because of absentees.
rules.evidence: 10 場 Brier：AI 0.450，市場 0.436，基準 0.439，AI 最差。Lazio 因三名主力缺陣被壓低，市場 1.45 更接近，最後 3-0；Monza 主勝只給 25.5% 卻 3-0 贏；Bologna 對 Udinese 因 K. Davis 缺陣過度看低客隊，結果 1-1。

rules.zh: 全場黃牌比基準少 1 張，上半場黃牌少 0.5 張；裁判的賽季出牌平均只當參考，不要直接套用。例外：弱隊早早落後、被迫壓上追分時，弱隊黃牌不減，犯規要加 2 到 3 次。
rules.en: Shade total yellow cards 1.0 below baseline and 1st-half yellows 0.5 below; use the referee's season card average only as a weak input. Exception: when an underdog falls behind early and must chase, don't cut its cards, and add 2–3 fouls for that side.
rules.evidence: 全場黃牌偏差 +1.44，上半場 +0.76（10 場）。Como 對 Cagliari 0 張、Juventus 對 Venezia 0 張；Parma 對 Roma、Sassuolo 對 Genoa、Monza 對 Fiorentina 都只有 1 張。反例：Frosinone 早早落後，4 張黃牌、17 次犯規。

rules.zh: 全場犯規比基準少 1.5 次，上半場犯規少 0.8 次。
rules.en: Shade total fouls 1.5 below baseline and 1st-half fouls 0.8 below.
rules.evidence: 全場犯規偏差 +1.32，上半場 +0.87（10 場）；Parma 對 Roma 實際 6 對 9，預測 10 對 11；Como 對 Cagliari 實際 18 次，預測 20.5 次。

rules.zh: 角球按比賽走勢分配，不要平均分給兩隊：預期一方控球超過 58% 而且比分可能僵持時，該隊角球加 1.5 到 2；落後一方被迫長時間壓上時，落後方角球加 2 到 3；熱門隊大概率早早領先或者賽程密集時，熱門隊下半場角球減 1.5。
rules.en: Distribute corners by game state, not evenly: if one side is expected to have >58% possession and the score may stay tight, add 1.5–2 corners to that side; a trailing side forced to push for long spells gets +2–3; when the favourite is likely to lead early or has a congested schedule, cut its 2nd-half corners by 1.5.
rules.evidence: 主導方角球被低估：Napoli 實際 8（預測 5.6）、Bologna 8（預測 5.4）、Lazio 9（預測 5.0）、Roma 8（預測 7）。落後方：Fiorentina 實際 7（預測 4.3）、Frosinone 9（預測 5.8）。熱門隊領先後角球變少：Como 實際 3（預測 7.4）、Juventus 5（預測 8.2），兩隊下半場都很少角球。

rules.zh: 熱門隊勝率 60% 以上、對手是防守差或連敗的球隊時，首選比分之外，至少要列出一個淨勝 3 球以上的比分；熱門隊預期進球加 0.3，總進球不要低於市場的大小球中位線。
rules.en: When the favourite is ≥60% against a leaky or losing side, include at least one 3+ goal-margin scoreline beyond the main pick, add 0.3 to the favourite's expected goals, and don't set total goals below the market O/U midpoint.
rules.evidence: 總進球偏差 -0.79（10 場）。Lazio 3-0、Parma 1-5 Roma、Juventus 4-0、Milan 5-1，四場都遠超預測的 1-0/2-0/0-3/2-1，都是落後方崩潰或壓上後被反擊打穿。

rules.zh: 半場更新時不要過度依賴半場比分：熱門隊 xG 或射正明顯領先、半場卻 0-0 時，平局機率最多加 5 個百分點；作客隊領先、但主隊射正持平或更多時，客勝不要調到 65% 以上。
rules.en: At half-time, don't overreact to the scoreline: if the favourite leads clearly on xG/shots on target but it's 0-0, raise the draw by at most 5 pts; if the away side leads while the home side matches or beats it on shots on target, don't push the away win above 65%.
rules.evidence: Napoli 對 Torino 半場 xG 1.31 對 0.07，平局被調到 35%，最後 1-0；Juventus 半場主勝降到 48%，最後 4-0；Atalanta 對 Inter 半場把 Inter 勝調到 72.6%，最後 4-4；Parma 對 Roma 半場轉保守，最後 1-5。

rules.zh: 惡劣天氣（大雨、強風）不要用來提高平局機率或下調總進球，頂多微調角球和傳中相關數字。
rules.en: Don't use bad weather (heavy rain, strong wind) to raise the draw or lower total goals; at most make small tweaks to corners/crossing-related numbers.
rules.evidence: Bologna 對 Udinese 大雨強風下 29 次射門、xG 合計 3.35；Sassuolo 對 Genoa 因天氣加重平局，結果 0-2；Juventus 對 Venezia 因天氣和輪換壓低進球上限，結果 4-0。

rules.zh: 客隊作客 xG 的樣本少（作客場次 6 場以下）時，往聯賽平均拉回一半；主力前鋒缺陣時，要看替補攻擊手的質素，不要直接大幅調低該隊進球。
rules.en: When a side's away xG comes from a small sample (≤6 away games), regress it halfway to the league average; when a main striker is out, judge the replacement attackers' quality instead of sharply cutting that team's goals.
rules.evidence: Sassuolo 對 Genoa：賽前用 Genoa 作客 xG 0.73，實際全場 2.11；Bologna 對 Udinese：K. Davis 缺陣，但 Zaniolo 帶動 Udinese 打出 1.65 xG。

rules.zh: 兩隊都是高壓、打法開放的球隊（例如 Atalanta 對頂級球隊），或者市場只輕微看好一方（50% 左右）而兩隊防守都差時，平局和冷門機率都不要壓低：平局不要低於 25%，受讓一方的勝率不要低於 28%。
rules.en: When both sides are high-pressing and open (e.g. Atalanta vs a top side), or the market only mildly favours one team (~50%) with two leaky defences, keep draw/upset probabilities wide: draw no lower than 25%, underdog win no lower than 28%.
rules.evidence: Atalanta 4-4 Inter（平局只給 21.5%，雙方 xG 都超過 3）；Monza 3-0 Fiorentina（主勝只給 25.5%，兩隊 xG 1.66 對 1.78）；Bologna 1-1 Udinese（平局給 25%）。

playbook.summary_zh: 第一版意甲守則：勝平負改為緊貼市場（AI Brier 比市場差），黃牌和犯規整體下調，角球按比賽走勢分配，熱門隊對弱隊時預留大比分，半場更新不要因比分過度反應，天氣不再用來加平局。
playbook.summary_en: First Serie A playbook: keep 1X2 close to the market (AI Brier is worse than the market), shade cards and fouls down overall, allocate corners by game state, leave room for big wins when a favourite faces a weak side, avoid half-time overreaction to the scoreline, and stop using weather to boost draws.
